message.content: Hey, pull up the client files for the Van der Merwed wedding. I need to finalize the invoice before I head out for my run. It’s been a long weekend.

content.text: I have the Van der Merwed file open. The total comes to R145,000. Would you like me to generate the PDF invoice now, or do you want to adjust the payment schedule first?

message.content: Keep the schedule as is. Send it to them. Also, check if the deposit has cleared. I’m trying to remember if I saw the notification yesterday or if it was the day before. My brain is still foggy from Sunday.

content.text: The deposit of R45,000 cleared this morning at 8:02 AM. I’ve attached the receipt to the invoice email draft. Shall I send it now?

message.content: Yes, go ahead. And while you're at it, look at the gear list for the food shoot next Tuesday. I’m worried about the lighting kit.

content.text: I see you’re planning to use the Profoto B10X Plus. The battery indicator is at 82%, which should be sufficient for a half-day shoot. Do you want me to book a rental backup battery just in case?

message.content: No, don't bother. I’ll charge it tonight. I need to focus on something else. I was thinking about the portfolio update. I’m only considering Cape Town Art Space for the alternative venue. I haven't decided yet, but I’m leaning that way.

content.text: Noted. I’ll flag Cape Town Art Space as a potential option for your portfolio review. Did you make that decision today, or was it on Sunday 15 March when you were looking at the photos?

message.content: It was Sunday 15 March. I was scrolling through their gallery and it just clicked. Anyway, let’s get back to work. What about the editing for the Smiths’ engagement shoot? The client wants the raw files too.

content.text: The Smiths' engagement shoot is scheduled for delivery on March 20. The raw files are currently in the 'Pending Delivery' folder. Would you like me to prepare the secure download link for the edited images first, or wait until you’ve finished the final retouching?

message.content: Wait until I finish. I want to make sure the skin tones are right. Also, remind me about my run today. I changed my route recently.

content.text: Your usual route is Signal Hill, but you updated your profile on Sunday 15 March to Llandudny Beach. Shall I sync your watch with the new coastal route?

message.content: Yes, sync it. And one more thing. My mother’s birthday was last week, right? I need to make sure I didn’t miss sending her the card.

content.text: Your mother’s birthday was 2026-03-04. I see a digital card was sent on that date. You’re all set there.
